draft.weaknessQuote: Gets by with athleticism over craftsmanship.
draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.83, the 205th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 26th of 32 at WR. He went 191st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (92nd percentile). Testing concerns: vertical jump (1st percentile), broad jump (3rd percentile). College production: 1,043 receiving yards in 2022, 10th of 32 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the New Orleans Saints (practice squad). 32 career games and 11 starts over 2 completed seasons. Still developing: 2 AV in 2024. Versus the typical Year-2 wide receiver who played: 172 receiving yards against a median of 290, below the norm.
